# assets

* `logo.svg` - the logo (vector).
* `screenshots/*.png` - **real** screenshots of the library, generated by `node tools/screenshots.mjs` (never mock-ups). `hero.png` is the README banner; `social-preview.png` (1280 x 640) is the image to upload in GitHub: *Settings -> General -> Social preview*.
* `demo.gif` - the drag-select animation: `node tools/screenshots.mjs` writes the frames to `assets/_frames/`, then `python3 tools/make-gif.py` assembles them.
